title: Free mein apna Chat with PDF app banao - 4 open-source tools
content:
Apne PDFs se baat karne wala app, BINA EK RUPAYA DIYE. Aaj main aapko poora stack dikhata hoon.
Is idea ka naam hai RAG, retrieval augmented generation.
Simple bhasha mein, AI pehle aapke document mein sahi paragraph dhoondhta hai, phir usi ke basis pe jawab deta hai.
IT DOES NOT GUESS from memory. It answers from your file.
Aur iske liye aapko kisi paid tool ki zaroorat nahi hai.
Tool number one, Ollama.
Ye aapke laptop pe open models chalata hai. Ek command, aur model aapke system pe ready.
Aapka data AAPKE COMPUTER SE BAHAR NAHI jaata. For private documents, that matters a lot.
Ollama pe hi ek embedding model milta hai, nomic-embed-text.
Ye aapke PDF ke har chunk ko numbers mein badalta hai, taaki computer meaning se search kar sake, sirf words se nahi.
Tool number two, Chroma.
Ye ek open-source vector database hai. Saare chunks yahan store hote hain.
Jab aap sawaal poochte ho, Chroma sabse relevant chunks nikaal ke deta hai.
Ab sawaal ye hai, in sab ko jodta kaun hai?
Tool number three, LlamaIndex.
Ye framework PDF load karta hai, usse chunks mein todta hai, Chroma mein daalta hai, aur Ollama wale model se jawab banwata hai.
A few lines of Python, and the pipeline is ready.
Aur agar aapko code nahi likhna, toh tool number four, Open WebUI.
Ye ChatGPT jaisa interface deta hai jo Ollama ke saath chalta hai. Document upload karo aur seedha sawaal poocho.
Maan lo aapki company ki do sau page ki HR policy hai.
Employee poochta hai, "Casual leave ka rule kya hai?" Aur app seedha sahi section dikha deta hai.
That is the kind of tool businesses actually pay for.
Mera take simple hai.
Agar aap AI engineer banna chahte ho, toh PEHLA PROJECT YAHI BANAO. Ye har interview mein kaam aata hai.
Comment RAG and I'll DM you all four links.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
